integrity: The proof uses the published planar anisotropic Cheeger representation, exact equivariance of Minkowski erosion and addition under common orthogonal symmetries, and a compactness argument for boundary contact. No finite computation is substituted for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The divisibility relation k|k_tilde is sufficient rather than necessary. The theorem treats convex planar domains and norm-generated centrally symmetric Wulff bodies; it does not address nonconvex domains or classify individual polygon-side contacts.
title: Common rotational symmetry forces anisotropic Cheeger edge regularity
